heroSubtitle: Every project is unique. Tell us what you need and JTH Graphix Production will prepare a tailored custom quotation that fits your goals, scope, and budget.
quoteIntroText: We don't use one-size-fits-all pricing. Each quote is prepared based on your specific project scope, complexity, and requirements — so you only ever pay for what your project truly needs.

quoteProcess.title: Submit Your Request
quoteProcess.description: Tell us about your project — the service you need, your goals, and any requirements or references you have.

quoteProcess.title: Consultation
quoteProcess.description: We review your brief and reach out to clarify scope, timelines, and expectations before preparing your quote.

quoteProcess.title: Receive Your Quote
quoteProcess.description: You get a clear, itemized custom quotation tailored to your project scope — no hidden fees, no surprises.

quoteProcess.title: Project Approval
quoteProcess.description: Review the quote, confirm your approval, and we kick off the project on an agreed timeline.

quoteProcess.title: Project Delivery
quoteProcess.description: We deliver quality work with revisions built into the process, and we stay available after handover.

pricingFactors.label: Project Complexity
pricingFactors.description: Simple one-off designs cost less than multi-asset or multi-platform projects.

pricingFactors.label: Number of Deliverables
pricingFactors.description: The more assets, pages, or materials you need, the more tailored your quote becomes.

pricingFactors.label: Revision Scope
pricingFactors.description: Clear revision rounds are scoped up front so you know exactly what's included.

pricingFactors.label: Turnaround Time
pricingFactors.description: Urgent timelines may require expedited scheduling, which we discuss transparently.

pricingFactors.label: Print or Digital Output
pricingFactors.description: Print-ready production specs and digital optimization are factored into your quote.

pricingFactors.label: Strategy Depth
pricingFactors.description: Brand strategy, research, and planning add depth to projects that need more than visuals.

allCustomNote: All services are quoted per project — no hidden fees, no surprises.
ctaTitle: Ready for a Free Custom Quote?
ctaText: Tell us what you need and JTH Graphix Production will prepare a tailored quotation — transparent, itemized, and aligned with your goals.
